build_multiscale_attention_module: build a MultiScaleAttention module with configurable pooling, relative positional embeddings, and online memory caching
build_multiscale_block_module: build a MultiScaleBlock transformer block combining MultiScaleAttention with MLP and skip connection pooling
run_attention_pool: run attention_pool to apply 3D pooling on tensor features while preserving class token embeddings
run_cal_rel_pos_spatial: run cal_rel_pos_spatial to compute spatial relative positional embeddings for attention scores
run_cal_rel_pos_temporal: run cal_rel_pos_temporal to compute temporal relative positional embeddings for attention scores
run_mask_memory: run mask_memory to mask cached memory so videos cannot attend to memory from different videos
run_get_spatial_embeddings: run get_spatial_embeddings to sample relative positional embedding matrices for height and width dimensions
run_get_rel_pos: run get_rel_pos to interpolate relative positional embeddings to a target dimension size
run_get_spatial_rel_score: run get_spatial_rel_score to compute final attention scores with spatial positional embeddings
run_get_conv_q: run get_conv_q to apply a convolution function on query tensor features with class token handling
review_multiscale_attention_forward: review the MultiScaleAttention forward pass for QKV projection, pooling, memory caching, and attention computation
review_multiscale_block_forward: review the MultiScaleBlock forward pass for normalization, attention, skip pooling, and MLP residual connections
refactor_multiscale_attention_causal: refactor the MultiScaleAttention causal masking logic to support variable temporal sequence lengths
refactor_multiscale_attention_online_mem: refactor the MultiScaleAttention online memory caching to support dynamic batch size handling
summarize_attention_module: summarize the MemViT attention module supporting multi-scale 3D pooling, relative positional embeddings, and online memory
